Notes: fractions are racing-space (sceneryCoordinates: "racing", baku.js:19) with startFrac 0 so no _sceneryShift hazard was found; every K(s) call is node-converted. Night lighting is geometry (emissive bulbs, window bands, pools) - the 34 lamp posts have no dynamic point-light registration in this file; real light comes from furniture lamp 'globe' via the engine lamp cap (not inspected). Dressing exclusions (baku.js:17-22) remove city/foliage/lighting over 0.36-0.56 and the whole left side 0.58-0.97, which is why the Caspian side is dark at night.

Screenshot gallery

Method: tools/shot/shot.mjs --batch, TLX backend, SwiftShader, 960x540, orbit camera (az/el defaults) at 6 lap fractions (0, 17, 33, 50, 67, 83%) plus eye height. Stills only; z-fight shimmer and animated flame glow cannot be judged. Notes under dry-day frames apply to the same position in other sets unless a set note says otherwise.

day / dry

Baseline. Blue sky, saturated grass, grid-textured buildings.

day / overcast

Only slightly flatter/darker than dry; sky still blue-violet - weak weather response.

day / fog

Light grey haze; far skyline still crisp at 300+ m. Fog looks weaker than the def's fogDensity 0.0016 (baku.js:30) implies for a street_night theme.

day / wet

Road and grass go glossy/dark; grass shelves read as mirror pools (p50). Day still reads as day (post PR #1979 lighting merge).

day / rain

Darker, rain streaks, strong reflections on the ground plane; buildings keep colour.

day / storm

Darkest day look; heavy streaks; other cars visible on grid at p33. Still reads as day-storm, not night.

dusk / dry

Warm orange horizon, lamps and window bands lit; best-looking set. Lamp pools visible on road.

dusk / rain

Lights and reflections work; whole scene brownish-grey.

night / dry

Lamps and lit crown bands fire; Caspian side and far buildings fall to near-black; sea has no moon/sky reflection.

night / rain

Very dark; p0 and p83 nearly unreadable. Road reflections of lamps and kerbs are the only cues.

Not captured / uncertain

  • No dawn set, no storm at dusk/night, no trackside/cinematic cams, eye view only 3 day + 2 night frames (cut for time; all 65 captured in about 12 min, so the cut was a choice, not a budget limit).
  • Orbit camera auto-steps round obstacles, so night p83 frames show a different framing (dark mass) than day p83; the same lap fraction is not the same view across sets.
  • Animated flame glow, Ferris wheel motion, rain on kerbs and shimmer/z-fight were not judged from stills.
  • Real-world dimensions (lap 6.003 km, Flame Towers heights, Maiden Tower 29.5 m) are from memory/brief, not re-fetched.
  • Defects 1 and 5 are attributed by position/call-site, not confirmed by removing the prop.
  • Whether concrete walls exist at 2.0 m near frac 0.17 (not visible in frame #02) was not verified.
  • Per-frame lamp point-light behaviour (engine lamp cap) not inspected.
